It is withheld because the market capitalisation behind it (7,725,370,270 ZAR) carries no price date, and the 2.00 ZAR price it implies is not the market row's own dated print (1.95 ZAR at 2026-10-09). An undated price behind a valuation is not auditable. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
